original_comment: The most important family of models is absent. Three of the six models are naive baselines, and the spatio-temporal architectures cited in the related work, including the transformer and the convolutional-recurrent models, are never run. Further, the related work on time-series forecasting, uncertainty-aware prediction, and heterogeneous feature integration could be expanded slightly. Studies such as Separating the Predictable Part of Returns with CNN-GRU-Attention from Inputs to Predict Stock Returns, Enhancing Stock Ranking Forecasting by Modeling Returns with Heteroscedastic Gaussian Distribution, and A Hierarchical Deep Model Integrating Economic Facts for Stock Movement Prediction may provide useful perspectives on temporal feature learning, uncertainty modeling, and the integration of contextual information.
